name: clinical-manuscript-plugin
description: Evidence-grounded clinical manuscript writing, statistical audits, major/minor journal revisions, point-by-point reviewer responses and verified rebuttal letters.

interface.shortDescription: Medical manuscript writing, revisions and reviewer responses
interface.longDescription: Draft and audit clinical, epidemiological and public-health manuscripts. New v1.1 Major Revision workflow parses reviewer comments into traceable requests, plans evidence-supported changes, cross-checks claimed reanalyses and manuscript edits, handles reviewer conflicts and R1/R2 follow-ups, and assembles point-by-point rebuttal drafts. Requires human scientific signoff.
defaultPrompt: Use Clinical Manuscript Audit to plan my Major Revision: categorize all reviewer comments, identify additional analyses, and create a point-by-point response matrix without inventing changes.
Check my Response to Reviewers against the revised manuscript, statistical evidence, and actual page/line locations before resubmission.
Audit the completed statistical tables and methods before drafting a clinical Results section.
